verdict.rationale: Neon's pricing page explicitly advertises a genuinely usable free tier: 'Build and learn free with no time limits and no credit card required' plus generous limits like 100 projects and unlimited team members, and community commentary corroborates ease of quickly spinning up real databases (fast provisioning, serverless scale-to-zero keeping costs low for hobby/prototype use). Scale-to-zero and branching further support running real prototypes cheaply before committing to paid tiers. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of free-tier limits/usability (vs. paid-tier complaints dominating community threads), and explicit compute/storage caps for the free tier are not detailed in the pack.
